referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes the European production of solid bleached board (SBB) in a mix of integrated and non-integrated mills - including transports to paper mill, wood handling, chemical pulping and bleaching rsp. pulp handling, board production, energy production on-site and internal waste water treatment.; Geography: Data from a finnish database and from the CER of one European producer used as European average data.
referenceFunction.localName: Solid bleached board, SBB, at plant
referenceFunction.name: Solid bleached board, SBB, at plant

geography.text: Data from a finnish database and from the CER of one European producer used as European average data.

representativeness.extrapolations: Assumption made that 75% are produced in integrated mills and 25% in non-integrated mills.
representativeness.productionVolume: Total European boxboard production in 2000: 11'664 kt (CEPI statistics)
